verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an accounts-payable Bills API for creating and managing vendor invoices, and AgentOS, a toolkit for AI agents acting on a production account. A user could combine these with their own AI extraction to create bills for review, but nothing shows Airwallex itself reading incoming bills with AI. missing for 10: first-party AI/OCR bill capture, auto-population of payee and payment details from bill documents, a review/approval step for AI-drafted bills, AgentOS coverage of bills, independent corroboration.
